name: Persistent Dev State
description: Persist user-scoped tool state in a named volume that survives rebuilds

persistVsCodeExtensions.description: Persist the remote user's ~/.vscode-server/extensions directory in the state volume.

additionalHomeDirs.description: Comma-separated list of additional remote-user home-relative directories to persist (for example: .npm,.cache/pip,.local/share/pnpm/store).
